text: Ironvale Athletic start a swift counter-attack from their defensive left, with Jonah Lindgren intercepting the ball about 16 metres from their own goal. The ball moves forward through Aiden Morales and then Teo Quinlan who advances sharply down the centre. Quinlan sends a through pass into space behind Redmond Rovers’ high defensive line on the left side of the attacking third. Jonah Lindqvist receives the ball around 5 metres from goal, dribbles closer and strikes with his foot to score at the far end, putting Ironvale Athletic 1-0 ahead early in the match.
